# Shape the roadmap

## Inputs

- the selected plan root `PROJECT.md`;
- the selected plan root `CAPABILITIES.md` when present;
- the selected plan root `ROADMAP.md`;
- relevant backlog, Inbox, research, and system files.

## Outputs

- updated roadmap rows for the selected plan root;
- milestone associations;
- explicit notes on blockers, overlaps, enablers, or proposed splits.

## Procedure

1. Read the selected plan root project intent, capability map, roadmap, and any relevant backlog, Inbox, research, or system files.
2. Decompose the project into bounded vertical slices using NOW, NEXT, and LATER horizons.
3. Keep near-term slices demonstrable and distant slices lightly elaborated.
4. Make boundaries, dependencies, and milestone associations explicit.
5. Prefer end-to-end learning over horizontal preparatory decomposition.

## Checks

- each near-term slice is demonstrable;
- boundaries are explicit;
- dependencies are visible;
- the slice is vertical rather than a default horizontal layer;
- distant work remains lightly elaborated.

## Escalate when

- roadmap coherence depends on changing project intent;
- a slice is too large to make tasking meaningful;
- dependencies invalidate the proposed order.
